alias_note: CoTume+ remains unresolved. Do not silently equate it with CoTime+.

cards.discriminator_or_test: Reject a purported delta if units/denominators/scopes differ; measure reconstruction accuracy and time.
cards.nonclaim: No universal numerical delta between ethics and physics; incomparable dimensions remain incomparable.
cards.proposal: Delta is meaningful only across comparable units, populations, time windows and measurement definitions.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: A trusted plain-text change log with explicitly named denominator and version.
cards.title: CoDeltaBasis+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Reject the claim P(X|Y) = P(Y|X); require evidence of reversibility before reversing causal arrows.
cards.nonclaim: Statistical association does not establish causal effect; inverse model does not imply an inverse physical process.
cards.proposal: Use different type tags for inverse conditional, logical converse, temporal replay, counterfactual intervention, backcasting and symmetry; none implies another.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Ordinary logic/causal inference notation and clearly annotated Markdown.
cards.title: CoInverseType+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Verify named direction/scope/observer and freeze information cutoff per view; compare view comprehension to ordinary dashboard.
cards.nonclaim: Views may disagree and may be non-equivalent, non-composable or not predictive.
cards.proposal: A forecast packet may encode directional lenses: future forecast, past explanation, counterfactual, local-to-global, global-to-local, cross-domain and inside/outside CoAll.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Existing multidimensional data cubes, causal DAGs and time-series dashboards.
cards.title: CoDirectionAtlas+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Supply the finite two-period example in the executable fixture; require aggregated and group-wise comparisons and a fixed-mix counterfactual.
cards.nonclaim: The synthetic example says nothing about real-world causality or prevalence.
cards.proposal: Aggregate trends can oppose all within-group trends when population composition changes (Simpson-style reversal).
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Simple spreadsheet grouped counts with matched rates and denominators.
cards.title: CoScaleInversion+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Prohibit any input observed after issuance for forecasts; keep revised historical knowledge separate; compare future-only error and planning feasibility.
cards.nonclaim: Reconstructing the past after seeing outcomes does not establish foresight.
cards.proposal: A forecast, a retrodiction and a backcast are different tasks with different evidence-cutoff and success criteria.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Ordinary version-controlled prequential evaluation, historical control series and explicit goal-seeking planning.
cards.title: CoRetroPredict+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Require pre-registered source-to-target mapping; evaluate on unseen target domain; report mapping losses and group harms.
cards.nonclaim: Global validity is not inferred from local success; CoAll graph inclusion grants no authority over outside systems.
cards.proposal: Local, global, inside-CoAll and outside-CoAll transfers require explicit invariants, boundary conditions and target-domain holdouts.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Standard stratified analysis and domain adaptation with a well-maintained comparison table.
cards.title: CoContextTransfer+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Small synthetic target-feasibility example plus a hard-gated rights scenario; compare human decision quality and effort to simple baseline.
cards.nonclaim: A G_dSide framing is a revisable value lens, not a measurable divine command or automatic action authority.
cards.proposal: Select robust, consent-respecting actions from multiple feasible futures; preserve incomparable good options rather than crown a scalar winner.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: A strong ordinary decision table of cost, harm, reversibility, alternative, and explicit stakeholder constraints.
cards.title: CoStrategicPareto+

cards.discriminator_or_test: Inject duplicated reports, synthetic feedback loops and later contradictory evidence; verify confidence cannot rise from repetition alone.
cards.nonclaim: No claim that recursively braided output improves truth, forecasting, or returns by itself.
cards.proposal: Reinforcing a repeated pattern without independent evidence can amplify error; each boost needs a dissent, negative-control and expiration path.
cards.strong_legacy_baseline: Append-only contradiction ledger and automated expiry using off-the-shelf version control.
cards.title: CoEchoDamp+
